game.title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League
game.blurb: Action shooter starring Harley Quinn, King Shark, Captain Boomerang and Deadshot, from Rocksteady Studios, released 2024-02-02. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League" or "Suicide Squad: Kill The Justice League". arkhamcity.fandom.com (the Arkham series wiki) answers the API under "Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League", with about 235 linked pages, mostly characters and places such as "Amanda Waller", "Brainiac", "Batman" and "Bizarro"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "TestApp200" (a placeholder name); the store list confirms app 315210 as "Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League". 8 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter, though "Into the Angry Planet" (4.1%) and "Welcome to the Jungle!" (10.1%) have low unlock rates and may be later content. "Choices" and "Grand Experiment" (gear work by Penguin and Toyman) are in the gear chapter, not the Support Squad chapter. The four playable characters named in the blurb come from the max-level achievements. Online play may be needed for some content.
